The '''63rd Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2010, were presented on January 29, 2011, at the [[Hollywood and Highland Center]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Kilday|first1=Gregg|title='King's Speech' Director Tom Hooper Tops 2011 DGA Awards|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/dga-2011-award-winners-announced-94341|access-date=January 20, 2018|work=The Hollywood Reporter|date=January 29, 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Finke|first1=Nikki|title=Directors Guild Awards: Tom Hooper Wins For 'The King's Speech' On His First Try|url=https://deadline.com/2011/01/directors-guild-awards-winners-101820/|website=Deadline|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 29, 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Tom Hooper wins DGA Feature Film Award for "The King's Speech" |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2011/0130-Tom-Hooper-wins-DGA-Feature-Film-Award.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=August 9, 2018 |date=January 30, 2011}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Carl Reiner]].<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Sets Host and Presenters for 63rd Annual DGA Awards Dinner|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2011/0125-DGA-Awards-Presenters-Announced.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 25, 2011}}</ref> The nominees for the feature film category were announced on January 10, 2011,<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=DGA announces film nominees|url=https://variety.com/2011/film/awards/dga-announces-film-nominees-1118029980/|access-date=January 20, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 10, 2011}}</ref> the nominations for the television and commercial categories were announced on January 11, 2011,<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Awards Nominees for TV and Commercials|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2011/0111-DGA-Awards-Nominees-for-TV-and-Commercials.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 11, 2011}}</ref> and the nominees for documentary directing were announced on January 12, 2011.<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=DGA names documentary award nominees|url=https://variety.com/2011/film/awards/dga-names-documentary-award-nominees-1118030135/|access-date=January 20, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 12, 2011}}</ref>
